name: alert_action_var_chain
prompt: Author a FortiSOAR playbook with a manual trigger that fetches an alert via a `find_record` step on the `alerts` module (filtered by a `uuid` passed in as a playbook parameter), then updates that same alert with an `update_record` step whose `record` IRI comes from the fetched data via `{{ vars.steps.<step_name> }}`. Make sure the variable reference uses the underscore-joined step display name (NOT the YAML id), and emit the complete YAML.
notes: Tests the vars.steps.<name> rule that LLMs frequently get wrong (use id or UUID instead).

ir_assertions.note: downstream step references the fetched data
the reference is DOWNSTREAM of the fetch, not beside it
